subject: Chromatin particles from dying cells drove a two-phase inflammatory response
script: From Agewell Brief: Chromatin particles from dying cells drove a two-phase inflammatory response. Cell-free chromatin particles from dying cells enter immune cells and activate STING in a biphasic pattern, linking cell death to DNA damage and sterile inflammation—a mechanism with deep roots in the biology of stress and adaptation. Circulating cfChPs enter immune cells within minutes. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
